title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your assistant's program calls the model for step 2 of a request. What lets the model use the result of the tool it requested in step 1?

options.text: The model stores that result internally after step 1 and recalls it
The program includes that result in the text it sends at step 2
The context window keeps results between calls without any sending
The model fetches the result again by itself from the tool

items.stem: A request takes two model calls. The system prompt, tool definitions and the student's question total 2,100 tokens. The first call outputs a 100-token tool request. The tool returns 900 tokens. The second call then writes the final answer. How many input tokens does the model read across both calls in total?
A student passes the laser cutter training on Monday. On Thursday they start a new chat and the assistant must know they passed. Which design makes that work?

options.text: Use a model with a context window big enough for a week
Write a longer system prompt that tells the model to remember
Have the program save the status and load it at session start
Trust the model to keep every earlier chat on its own

items.stem: Your 300-page band saw manual is needed for a few questions a day. Which setup keeps the cost per request lowest while still answering from the manual?

options.text: Put the full manual in the context on every model call
Keep the manual outside and search it for matching passages
Summarize the manual once and never look at the pages again
Ask the model to write the manual from its training data

items.stem: A long booking conversation is close to filling the context window. Name one thing the program can do to keep the agent going, and say what it does to the context.
